steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, we failed.
Failed? How could that be?
Uh, wait, failed in what?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Don't worry, Chief. Nothing crucial.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It's about the investigation into Whitestone Industries. It's basically failed.
Has any investigator been attacked?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: No, the investigators are all fine. It's just that the progress with the investigation into Whitestone Industries isn't fine.
Oh, that's okay. I wasn't expecting that anything conclusive would come out of it so soon anyway.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I'll tell them to continue the investigation.
Good, but in the meantime, we can't let what we've achieved go to waste.
Get the interrogation room ready. I'm gonna have a little chat with Ms. Bai.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Yo, I've been expecting you.
Bai Yi is sitting in a relaxed posture, as if she's in her own home.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: A private conversation, huh? You want to discuss something shady, don't you?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Ah, don't be shy. Get it off your chest. I promise I won't make fun of you.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: And as usual, I get paid by the minute for my chatting service. Every minute is billable, even if you choose to be silent.

options: You're in no position to negotiate.

choices.text: You're in no position to negotiate.

steps.content: Sinners are obliged to cooperate in interrogations.
...You're being interrogated. Be serious.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Just kidding... I wouldn't actually charge you for such trivial stuff.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Ask away. I'm all ears.
The main reason I'm here today, I want to ask you about Whitestone Industries.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Whitestone Industries? Sure! I have so much to say about my company. Um...

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Can I interest you in our new package, a seven-day guided tour around Syndicate?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Place your order now, get 20% off.
I am curious about your business operations.
But that's not why I'm here. I'm here for the secrets behind Whitestone Industries.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Oh...
Bai Yi narrows her eyes and leans forward.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: So that's what you want to know... but, this is secret information we're talking about here...

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: I can give it to you free of charge, but, don't you think you should do something in return?
Bai Yi leans further.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: West District Mall, Big Discounts for a Limited Time Only, Invite Your Friends to Help Cut the Prices.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Latest Personal Terminals, Weapons, Tickets to DeadLover Radio Meet-and-greets... We provide all manner of sought-after merchandise.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: What are you waiting for? Scan the QR code and download the app!

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Scan the QR code and download the app!
Bai Yi points at her chest again.
You raise your terminal and scan the suspicious-looking QR code.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Haha, that's more like it.
The internet speed of the MBCC is incredible indeed. In the blink of an eye, the progress bar is full.

The next second, the screen of your terminal is assaulted by a colorful array of pop-up ads, with low-fidelity cheesy music blasting in the background. There are so many of them that you're overwhelmed as you try to turn them off.
You turn off the terminal and pocket it.
I've done what you asked. Now, you should hold up your end of the bargain.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Okey dokey.
Bai Yi stretches lazily.
Tell me the basics first.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Whitestone Industries exists to serve your needs, from walking your dog to taking revenge for you.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: It is a well-established company that values honesty and integrity, with a wide range of services and a high task-completion rate. It's been voted the most popular company in all of Syndicate five years running.
Your company was founded in N.F. 105, if I'm not mistaken?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Ah, you don't understand; in Syndicate, you can call your business well-established if it's stayed afloat for two years.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Cough cough... We only had two members when we started out. Later, we were joined by a third member. And ever since then, the team has been quite stable. Despite the lack of new blood, our business has been expanding.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: We've been growing our business steadily in Syndicate for many years. We even established a stable business relationship with the Legion, the big-time gang of Syndicate...

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Sigh... I don't remember what comes next. Anyway, all you need to know is this: Whitestone Industries is a big shot, and nobody in Syndicate can afford to be disrespectful to us, not even the Legion, which, by the way, used our services.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Do you follow me?
No, not really.  I mean, K.K. is also a member of Whitestone Industries, but her account is totally different from yours.
test
test
test
test
test
test
Here is K.K.'s testimony. Do you want me to read it to you?
...You are saying that Whitestone Industries is not in a good condition, right?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: An awfully terrible condition!

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: We're six months behind on rent. We've never paid any utility bill. At this rate, we'll soon starve!

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Che does nothing but plays cards and loafs around every day. Sometimes he'd disappear for days. When I do see him, he is full of excuses and nonsense. You simply can't make him do anything.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: I'm the one who has been doing all the work. What choice do I have?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: I deliver food, I unclog toilets—day in, day out. And the little money I earn will be all gone whenever Bai Yi botches up a commission and has to compensate the customer.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: She can't possibly have no idea why she's named one of the Three Pests of Syndicate... All she ever does is get into trouble and accumulate debts. How I wish she could just stop all that foolishness for a while!

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: I do feel hopeless sometimes. I feel I can't go on like this anymore...
If the situation is so bad, why didn't you leave?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: ...One is totally unreliable, the other won't lift a finger even if his life depends on it... And they don't cook; when I am out, they just have instant noodles.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: They have no shame. They even call me Mom. They'd definitely be dead without me.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Good for you, K.K., insulting me like that in front of the Chief...
I never thought the good old Ms. Bai was the deadbeat of the Three Pests of Syndicate. You do live up to the name.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: No, apparently, some malicious people are trying to ruin my reputation out of jealousy, I, um...
Bai Yi heaves a sigh.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Okay, Okay... What K.K. said is true, I admit. Our company is in a bit of a pickle.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: So, how does it benefit you, me admitting this?
I just want you to be honest with me, is all.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Huh? That's the reason? You guys are really twisted...
My next question is very important. Please answer honestly.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: How am I supposed to know?
Ms. Bai rolls her eyes.
But you've just said, you <i>established a stable business relationship with the Legion, the big-time gang of Syndicate<i>.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: What? Now I'm not allowed to brag? Besides, didn't you just expose me as a liar?
On the day BR-004 appeared, Che entered the Black Ring. Ordinary people can't survive in a Black Ring for that long, but Che was not affected.
Does Whitestone Industries have some hidden secrets?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: No.
Bai Yi's tone is curt.
You were up there at the top of the statue with Zoya, weren't you?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: No.
Bai Yi denies the claim.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Who'd risk their lives to get inside a Black Ring?
That day, Che said it's a friend of his who helped stall Zoya.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Could have been one of that little brat's cronies. I don't know any of them.
Where were you those few days?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Out for business. What else could I have been?
Can anyone vouch for that?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: What? You can't be serious... K.K. is having the time of her life in your bureau, Che is inside the Black Ring, how am I gonna find someone to vouch for me?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: I'm the boss of the company, and I have to work my fingers to the bone to put food on the table. It's so demeaning...
Bai Yi wipes the non-existent tears from the corners of her eyes, and steals a look at you.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: My employees are a bunch of Judases. I'm their boss, but they show me no respect. Now they are making me a scapegoat... Sob...
Obviously, Bai Yi is lying. But unfortunately, you don't have enough information to disprove all this mumbo jumbo of hers.
You decide to use the information you have to test your theory.
I guess I'll have to give you the benefit of the doubt on this for now.
But there's something else I want to ask you...

Since June, a certain organization has been quite active at ██ Street. They have been recruiting gangsters, and allegedly smuggling Mania weapons, among other things.
The MBCC caught a small ringleader of the organization. He said he was working for Whitestone Industries...
Care to explain, Ms. Bai?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Defamation! This is pure defamation!

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Must have been some senseless gangster. The balls on this guy! How dare he try to pin this on me?
So you're not involved in the Mania weapon business, even if you've been so hard-up for cash?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: This is ridiculous! I'll never stoop to that, no matter how poor I am.
Bai Yi snatches the clipboard from your hand. Pointing at the picture of the man, she starts hurling cursewords.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Who is this guy? I don't even know him. No way I'd hire someone I didn't know.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: And besides, Whitestone has three members: Che, K.K., and me. That's it; there's never been a fourth member...

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Wait a second. Could it be that Che has been getting in with people like this man?
Bai Yi's face is distorted with fury.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: That little brat! He loafs around all day, and now this... hanging out with people who are out to hurt the company's reputation.
Calm down. This is just your guess.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: I don't care. I'll make whoever poses as a member of Whitestone Industries pay!
Bai Yi steals another look at you.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: You've got to help me.
That's your own business. Why should I get involved?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: I can give you a hand in eradicating the dealings of Mania weapons in Syndicate, and you help me get rid of my impostor. Win-win!

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Don't tell me that the MBCC is not gonna do something about this Mania weapon business?

options: There's no way the bureau is staying out of that.

choices.text: There's no way the bureau is staying out of that.

steps.content: Bai Yi is not wrong. As long as Mania weapons are involved, you can't just stay on the sidelines, whether the other Whitestone Industries is real or not.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Great. You can rest assured, I'm gonna help you, and I'm not gonna drop the ball. I'll make whoever tries to be a counterfeit of me pay the price.
As things stand, you can't get more information out of Bai Yi for now.

Eradicating Mania is indeed the MBCC's top priority. It is your intention to get rid of the organization that deals in Mania weapons. Bai Yi's offer of help might be a chance for you to get to the bottom of the whole situation.
I'd love to use your help in this operation.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: You can count on me.
Bai Yi puts her palm on her chest.
You leave the interrogation room, and find that Nightingale is waiting in the doorway.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: How did the interrogation go? Everything all right?
Not really. Bai Yi's not very forthcoming. Looks like she's an old hand at dealing with a situation like this.
We don't have conclusive evidence at the moment. We're not able to expose her yet.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: So what are you going to do next?
Anyway, we have to do something about those Mania weapons.
You fish out your terminal.
I'm gonna get in touch with the response team. We must handle this problem as soon as possible. Maybe we can even fi...

steps.speaker: Ads
steps.content: Tailor-made Blades, Preorder for a Limited Time Only

steps.speaker: Ads
steps.content: Nitroglycerin for Sale, Discounts for Bulk Purchases!

steps.speaker: Ads
steps.content: Canned Food from Eastside, In Short Supply, First Come, First Served.
The moment you turn on your terminal, a dozen of in-your-face ads pop up, giving you a start.
You know what? Why don't you contact them for me? I have to go handle the dispatch thing. Ask the person in charge to meet me in my office in fifteen minutes.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Copy that.
You pocket the terminal, and hurry out of the premises.
